composition.default_relation: Use per-frame subtitle_relation; ghosts/orange/rings below text, giant foreground star and dark drips above text, remaining mixed/uncertain requires override/review.
composition.occlusion_holes: FX hidden by higher text are often transparent. Independent FX reuse with moved/replaced lyrics may expose these holes; do not claim seamless full effect shapes.

remaining_findings.fact: F591 retains 8361 clipped-contour stroke pixels but zero pink body pixels in those bounds. Canvas-cropped/open bodies are not invented.
Overlaid glyph/shadow footprint leaves holes in visible FX; original subtitle layer/order can cover them, arbitrary subtitle replacement cannot.
Ray orange and touching cameo gold become connected; fine contact region can contain prop gold. Isolated cameo F2221 is protected.
Black-on-black marks/letter contacts and bread/star gold require documented protection or constant-field inference; not exact original-alpha recovery.
Fine compression/estimated-matte fringes remain despite corrected eye/body, petal dark-line and contour regressions.
Zero supported pixels is not proof of an artist having used exactly zero alpha below source compression noise; no hidden values invented.
